known_mvp_tradeoffs: There is no pre-call reservation. Concurrent calls already in flight when the 25th handled call converges may create a visible practical overshoot.
Every first valid terminal ended post-call event counts once; error/not-connected lifecycle rows remain uncounted and notification remains pending until call_analyzed arrives.
Reporting is a minimized per-client Data Store query or sanitized CSV export; Analytics and CRM writes are absent.

Number reassignment is not a runtime feature or an initial-validation requirement. Do not reuse either test number during initial validation; after a test ends, preserve ownership metadata and place the number into a documented cooldown before any separately reviewed future reuse.
